summary.text: Doug Barrow is a No Party Affiliation candidate for the Florida House of Representatives, District 94, in the November 3, 2026 general election.
In a Ballotpedia survey, he said he is running to focus on local communities rather than party politics.

paragraphs.text: Barrow said in the survey that he would oppose irresponsible commercial expansion and data centers that threaten places like Jupiter Farms.
He also said he supports stronger public schools, better teacher pay, a fire station for underserved areas, and action to lower insurance costs.

Barrow listed protecting local communities, preserving rural Florida, responsible growth, property insurance reform, public safety, public schools and affordable homeownership among his policy interests.
